description: Prose humanization toolkit: the text-humanizer editor agent improves prose in any language without inventing content (25 local patterns, including replies that re-explain known context), register-aware (docs, business, personal) with a natural Italian profile, backed by the anti-ai-writing-patterns knowledge base and the humanize method behind /text-humanizer:humanize-text, with optional 5-dimension quality scoring. Self-contained generic leaf plugin with zero dependencies, consumed by digital-marketing and business and by coordinators in other marketplaces. Extracted from digital-marketing in marketplace 13.3.0.
name: text-humanizer
